newsitem.title: FINLAND: Finnish Apr C/A surplus FIM 1.3 billion - Cen Bank.
newsitem.headline: Finnish Apr C/A surplus FIM 1.3 billion - Cen Bank.

text.p: The Finnish current account surplus was 1.3 billion markka in April after an equally big surplus in March, the Bank of Finland said on Thursday.
It gave the following balance of payments figures (FIM bln):
(* The Bank of Finland said a negative figure marks an increase in reserves).

Finland's net foreign debt was 274.9 billion markka at end-April, up by 7.9 billion on end-March. The state's share of net foreign debt was 192.5 billion markka, up from 189.1 billion, the central bank said.
The net foreign debt rose mainly due to the weakening of the markka and to the rise in Finnish share prices, the Bank of Finland said.
